N_enrolled.short_description: Adjusted enrollment count used as the denominator for the exemption and up-to-date rates.
N_enrolled.long_description: OHA's "Adjusted Enrollment" figure, the denominator the workbook itself uses for every percent column it publishes; this ingest carries it over unchanged rather than deriving its own.

N_complete.long_name: Number of students up to date for all required vaccines
N_complete.short_description: Students who have completed every vaccine required for their grade.
N_complete.long_description: Count of students reported by OHA as having documentation for all required vaccines ("# With All Vaccines Required").
N_complete.statement: In {location}, {value} students were up to date for all required vaccines.

rate_complete.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for all required vaccines
rate_complete.short_description: Share of students who have completed every vaccine required for their grade.
rate_complete.long_description: Share of enrolled students with documentation for all required vaccines. For county rows this is recomputed from the summed school-level counts (N_complete / N_enrolled) rather than averaged from the schools' published percentages.
rate_complete.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

or_school_immunization.name: Oregon School Immunization Exemptions, K-12
or_school_immunization.organization: Oregon Health Authority, Public Health Division
or_school_immunization.description: Statewide K-12 school immunization workbook published each fall by the Oregon Health Authority (OHA). School-level rows carry the county (Agency), adjusted enrollment, the share up to date on all required vaccines, and a count and percent exempt per required vaccine (DTaP/Tdap, polio, varicella, MMR1, MMR2, HepB, HepA, plus any nonmedical exemption); this ingest enrollment-weights the school-level counts up to the county level by summing rather than averaging. OHA overwrites the workbook at a fixed URL each year, so the series is self-updating.
or_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the Oregon Health Authority; no access restrictions. County values are aggregates of school-level counts and may differ slightly from any official county figures OHA reports separately.
